observation: Round 2 falsified the stage-3/stage-5 pivot. Versus round 1 (proxy 0.5439, the best so far), round 2 fell to 0.5217: correspondence_f1@15 collapsed 0.181 -> 0.135, sam_fill_rate was flat (0.7676 -> 0.7674), ring_count_error stayed 0, and the only 'gain' was cosmetic depth_nan_ratio 0.169 -> 0.156. This is exactly the suspect pattern of experiences section 9 (evidence feature improves while the coherence/correspondence terms degrade), which the round-2 rationale itself pre-committed to revert. The round-2 detected_lines.png shows the oblique line set essentially unchanged (3 positive + 3 negative short segments, all in the right-most three rings at y~1465 and y~1625) and the ~0 deg horizontal fragment at (x~2300, y~800) is STILL present despite hough_threshold_horizontal 26 -> 45, so that change was a no-op and the f1 loss must come from the label boundaries moving, i.e. from enhancing.curvature_threshold 0.0004 -> 0.0008 (densifying edge points as surface blurs the K-edge depth step under the SAM crops) and/or sam.angle 6.12 -> 5.3. Both are therefore reverted. Structural facts unchanged across all rounds: recentre residual 3.6 cm, orient_axis_corr -0.999 with invariant ok, denoise retention 0.80, 10 synthetic verticals == 10 rings, K row snapped at y~1550 with 10 propagated prompts, det_real_detection_ratio 0 / fallback 1 (regime artefact of uniform_k_snap on continuous, not a defect). In the outlier map the K-edge bolt-pocket glyphs are present in every ring at y~1430-1470 and y~1600-1650, spaced ~45-50 px apart along x; round-1 maxLineGap 50 sits exactly at that spacing, so pockets in the left seven rings could not be chained into a single segment of minLineLength 40, while the right three rings happen to have denser glyphs. The oblique accumulator (22) and binarisation (112) have not yet been taken to their bounds.
rule: Ontology d7 (m_line_yield low; fallback triggered) -> f_missing_lines persists; upstream f_depth_holes and f_joint_oversmoothed are ruled out (voids are theta-gate/rail bands, joints are visible as dotted glyphs in the outlier map), so r_relax_hough remains the only in-bounds remediation. Experiences section 7 tuning order: stages 1-3 confirmed healthy in rounds 1-2, so this round stays in stage 4 and does NOT touch SAM geometry (round-2 evidence: stage-5/stage-3 changes cost f1 with no fill gain). Experiences section 9/10: a NaN-only improvement is cosmetic and must not be kept; revert it. Experiences section 5: never disturb the vertical count when it already equals the ring count; keep uniform_k_snap true so extra intersections cannot move the K row (m_prompt_count / m_spacing_regularity protected).
failure_mode: f_missing_lines (stage_4_detection) in the left seven rings: joint evidence is present but fragmented at ~45-50 px pocket spacing, so HoughLinesP maxLineGap 50 cannot bridge it and threshold 22 rejects the short chains. No f_depth_holes (family-normal voids), no f_joint_oversmoothed once curvature_threshold is returned to 0.0004, no orientation/centreline/gating defect. Round-2 introduced f_template_mismatch risk (sam.angle) and mild f_joint_oversmoothed (curvature 0.0008) -- both removed.
rationale: Return to the round-1 configuration as the base (it is the best measured point: proxy 0.5439, f1@15 0.181) and spend the final round on the untested remaining headroom of r_relax_hough, which round 1 showed to be safe (going 30->22 / 30->50 added zero spurious lines). (1) detecting.maxLineGap_oblique 50 -> 60 (bound max): the K-edge bolt pockets are ~45-50 px apart, so 60 clears the spacing and lets HoughLinesP chain adjacent pockets along the true +/-5.3 deg joint into segments that pass minLineLength 40 and the [5,10] deg angle filter; 50 was at the spacing boundary. (2) detecting.hough_threshold_oblique 22 -> 20 (bound floor): accept the shorter chains from sparser left-ring glyphs. (3) detecting.binary_threshold 112 -> 100 (bound floor): keep fainter dilated outlier pixels so the pocket glyphs are wider and easier to chain. (4) enhancing.curvature_threshold back to 0.0004 (round-1 value): removes the round-2 K-edge blurring that cost f1; the small NaN increase is accepted as non-cosmetic. (5) sam.angle omitted -> T3 prior 6.12 deg restored; K_height/segment_width untouched (measured 168 px / 240 px agree with priors). (6) hough_threshold_horizontal kept at 26 (round-1 value) so the horizontal path is identical to round 1 and any line-set change is attributable to the oblique relaxation alone; the (2300,800) fragment is insensitive to this knob anyway. (7) hough_threshold_vertical, pattern_tolerance 12, uniform_k_snap true unchanged so 10 verticals == 10 rings and the K row stays snapped at y~1550. Expected: ring_count_error 0 and sam_fill_rate ~0.77 unchanged; depth_nan_ratio back to ~0.169; f1@15 >= 0.181 if any additional K-edge segments appear in rings 1-7 (each new supported ring adds ~2 boundaries within 15 px), otherwise a reproduction of round 1. Downside is bounded: spurious obliques would have to fall in [5,10] deg on a nearly horizontal glyph field, which round 1 showed does not happen at 22/50.
